fields.name: classes
fields.label: Variant
fields.description: Select the search mode. Default: name/ZIP search. Location: auto-detects user location. Map: shows a map alongside results. Support: support-group finder.

fields.name: radius-options
fields.label: Radius Options
fields.description: Comma-separated radius options shown in the results select (e.g. '5 Miles, 10 Miles, 25 Miles'). Defaults to 5/10/25/50/100 Miles when blank.

fields.name: geo-button-label
fields.label: Geo Button Label
fields.description: Label for the 'Use my location' button shown in the location variant.

fields.name: terms-label
fields.label: Terms Label
fields.description: Heading above the Terms & Conditions checkbox (e.g. 'Terms & Conditions').

fields.name: terms-text
fields.label: Terms Text
fields.description: Checkbox label text. May include a hyperlink to the full T&C page.

fields.name: terms-error
fields.label: Terms Error Message
fields.description: Validation message shown when the user submits without accepting the Terms & Conditions.

fields.name: captcha-message
fields.label: Captcha Message
fields.description: Message displayed alongside the CAPTCHA challenge.

fields.name: results-title
fields.label: Results Title
fields.description: Heading shown above the results list (e.g. 'Results found').

fields.name: directions-label
fields.label: Directions Link Label
fields.description: Label for the 'Get Directions' link on each result card.

fields.name: details-label
fields.label: Details Button Label
fields.description: Label for the 'Show all practice details' toggle button on each result card.

fields.name: indication
fields.label: Indication
fields.description: PublisherName sent in the API request payload.

fields.name: exit-modal-id
fields.label: Exit Modal ID
fields.description: ID of the modal to open when a provider card is clicked (exit-like UX).

fields.name: anchor-id
fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.description: Sets the id attribute on the block for in-page anchor links.
